description: React component for managing team mode settings in Mattermost admin console, including toggles for syncing group members, allowing all members, and specifying allowed email domains.

methods.name: SyncGroupsToggle
methods.description: Toggle for syncing group members with the team.

methods.name: AllowAllToggle
methods.description: Toggle for allowing anyone to join the team.

methods.name: AllowedDomainsToggle
methods.description: Toggle and input for restricting team join to specific email domains.

methods.name: TeamModes
methods.description: Main component rendering team management settings panel with toggles.
